record.question: A government servant has acquired lien on a permanent post and is later appointed to officiate in another post. Under F.R. 13, what happens to his lien on the original post?
options: It is suspended and can be revived only after approval of the President.
It is terminated because officiating service creates a fresh lien.
It is retained while he is officiating in another post.
It is retained only if the officiating post carries lower pay.
